scripts.example:drift: pnpm --filter acme-ds-example exec girih generate react --check
scripts.docs: pnpm build && pnpm --filter acme-ds-example exec girih generate react && pnpm docs:data && pnpm docs:build
scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm example:check && pnpm example:drift
scripts.release: pnpm verify && pnpm pack:verify && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" publish --access public --publish-branch main
